name: faithful rewrite keeps every detail
original: Revenue grew 12% to $4.5 million in 2023, according to Jane Doe of Acme Corp.
rewritten: According to Jane Doe at Acme Corp, revenue rose 12% to $4.5 million in 2023.

name: lossy rewrite drops and invents details
original: Revenue grew 12% to $4.5 million in 2023, according to Jane Doe of Acme Corp.
rewritten: Revenue grew sharply to about $5 million, according to Acme.

name: citations, links and thousands separators
original: Prior work (Smith et al., 2020) and [3] found 1,000 cases. See https://example.com/report.
rewritten: Earlier studies (Smith et al., 2020) found 1000 cases, see https://example.com/report.

name: quotes and emails
original: She said "we will ship on Friday" and emailed ops@example.com.
rewritten: She promised to ship by Friday and emailed the team.

name: sentence-start words are not names; multi-word names
original: The meeting is in Paris. Then we fly to New York City on May 5.
rewritten: We meet in Paris, then fly to New York on 5 May, joined by Microsoft.

name: ranges, hyphenated names and possessives
original: I think COVID-19 cases fell in 2020-2021. Google's report on pages 10-12 agrees.
rewritten: Cases of COVID-19 dropped in 2020-2021, and the Google report on pages 10-12 agrees.

name: curly quotes match straight quotes
original: He wrote “ship it today” in the chat.
rewritten: In the chat he wrote "ship it today".
